I have implemented the `encryption` package and integrated streaming AES-256-GCM encryption into the dump pipeline on a new branch `feat/encryption`:

- **Streaming Encryption & Decryption** ([encryption.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mwbwe6bu/encryption/encryption.go)):
  - [`NewEncryptor`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mwbwe6bu/encryption/encryption.go#L35-L43) validates 32-byte keys and wraps [`ErrInvalidKey`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mwbwe6bu/encryption/encryption.go#L29) otherwise.
  - [`Encryptor.EncryptWriter`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mwbwe6bu/encryption/encryption.go#L45-L64) streams AES-256-GCM chunks up to 64KB with the 3-byte header (`0x4F 0x44 0x01`), 4-byte big-endian chunk length prefix (`nonce + ciphertext + tag`), unique 12-byte random nonces per chunk, 4-byte zero sentinel, and 32-byte HMAC-SHA256 trailer over all bytes between header and sentinel, with idempotent `Close()`.
  - [`DecryptReader`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mwbwe6bu/encryption/encryption.go#L179-L204) lazily initializes on `Read`, verifying header magic (`"invalid header"`), version (`"unsupported version"`), chunk authentication/truncation, and trailing HMAC (`"integrity"`).
- **Encryption Config & Key Loading** ([config.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mwbwe6bu/encryption/config.go)):
  - [`Config`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mwbwe6bu/encryption/config.go#L25-L33) and [`Config.Validate`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mwbwe6bu/encryption/config.go#L72-L77) validate case-insensitive key sources (`env`, `file`, `literal`, `derive`), required source-specific fields, and mutual exclusivity.
  - [`LoadKey`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mwbwe6bu/encryption/config.go#L129-L194) loads or derives 32-byte keys from environment variables, files, inline base64 strings, or passphrases with `>= 16`-byte base64 salts via PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256.
- **Job Config, Filenames & Handler Pipeline**:
  - Added `Encryption` (`encryption.Config`), [`Job.Encrypted`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mwbwe6bu/config/job.go#L143-L145), and exported [`Job.Validate`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mwbwe6bu/config/job.go#L119-L137) in [job.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mwbwe6bu/config/job.go).
  - Updated [`EnsureFileSuffix`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mwbwe6bu/fileutil/filenutil.go#L30-L46) and [`EnsureFileName`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mwbwe6bu/fileutil/filenutil.go#L48-L51) in [filenutil.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mwbwe6bu/fileutil/filenutil.go) with `shouldEncrypt bool` to append `.enc` after `.gz` idempotently.
  - Updated [`storageReadWriteCloser`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mwbwe6bu/handler/jobhandler.go#L32-L66) and [`JobHandler.save`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mwbwe6bu/handler/jobhandler.go#L69-L162) in [jobhandler.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mwbwe6bu/handler/jobhandler.go) to fail-fast on encryption key errors before storage operations and pipe `gzip.Writer` through `EncryptWriter`.
